E0402

Fallible call ignored as a statement

What

Fallible call ignored as a statement

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0402

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0402: tests/ui/task_capture.stderr.

Error [E1101]: `count` cannot cross the `task capture` boundary: the value writes shared state
  --> tests/ui/task_capture.jet:3:15
    |
  3 |     t :: task {
    |               ^
 Why: the `task capture` boundary can run concurrently with its owner; the write would race with the owner or require a hidden merge rule
 Fix: give it with `^`, freeze it with `freeze`, or share it with `shared`
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E1101

Error [E0402]: this call can fail and nothing checks it
  --> tests/ui/task_capture.jet:6:7
    |
  6 |     t.join()
    |       ^^^^
 Why: a fallible result can't be ignored — handle it or say failure is impossible
 Fix: use `?`, `??`, `panic ...`, or `.drop("reason")` to intentionally discard
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0402
